name: Smoothie Bouni spindle-module boards (family of two)
status_target: cad-clean-unqualified (best achievable without physical qualification); UNSUITABLE FOR FABRICATION until human review
hazard_rationale: Neither board carries mains: field-side voltages are <= 12 V (10 V VFD reference, 0-10 V, RUN contact, RS-485, 3.3 V isolated). The class is set conservatively because both boards are the isolation interface between a Smoothieboard (USB/PC-connected) and a VFD whose control terminals may be mains-referenced, and because the controlled load is a rotating spindle. A barrier failure or unintended RUN is a safety event. Per docs/board-design-process.md every mains/hazardous-class board is marked unsuitable for fabrication until human review, and disposition/self-review steps use the FRONTIER tier.
fabrication_status: UNSUITABLE FOR FABRICATION until a human has reviewed the isolation spacing derivation, the VFD interface assumptions and the safe-state behaviour. Every generated artefact (silkscreen, README, versions.json, renders) must carry this label.
generator: tools/make_contract.py with tools/bouni_layout.py (single source; rerun instead of editing this JSON)
function: Two separate Gadgeteer extension boards adapted from the two historical Bouni spindle boards of the Smoothieware spindle-module page: (A) PWM to 0-10 V analog speed reference + RUN contact, (B) UART to RS-485 for Modbus VFDs. Both add galvanic isolation relative to the originals.
scope: Two boards in one slug, built together in every version, each with its own KiCad project in attempt/versions/vNN/. Not included: DC spindle MOSFET/PWM driver and hobby ESC/servo (covered by the MOSFET and servo boards), mains switching, spindle speed feedback input, direction output, relay, firmware. See questions.md Q1.

shared_decisions: Both boards keep the HOST domain (Gadgeteer) and a FIELD domain (VFD) galvanically separate with a copper-free barrier strip across the full board width.
Both put J1 (IN) and J2 (CHAIN) on the north edge and the field terminal on the south edge; same hole logic (two NPTH on the barrier line, 20 mm apart).
Same naming: HOST nets GND/+3V3/+5V, FIELD ground GND_VFD (A) or GND_ISO (B).
family.version_layout: versions/vNN/ holds both projects: bsm-analog.* and bsm-rs485.* (kicad_pro, kicad_sch, kicad_pcb, kicad_dru, netlist, erc, drc, verify, routing json) plus one renders/ directory with analog-* and rs485-* prefixed files, one commands.json per board, bom.md per board, diagnostics.json. The .kicad_pro files sit in vNN/ so ${KIPRJMOD}/../../models/ and ${KIPRJMOD}/../../footprints/ resolve.
family.versions_rule: Both boards advance together: every version folder contains the complete package for both. Never overwrite earlier versions.

renders/ (populated + bare top/bottom/isometric PNG per board, assembly SVG/PDF, copper SVG, schematic PDF/SVG, commands.json with model provenance)

first_power_procedure: Inspect: board marked PROTOTYPE, no solder bridges across the barrier strip, jumper states match the factory table.

analog.name: Bouni spindle module A: Gadgeteer PWM to 0-10 V analog VFD speed reference plus isolated RUN contact
analog.function: Converts the host PWM on P-socket pin 7 into a filtered 0-10 V speed reference (VFD analog input) and the host GPIO on pin 6 into a floating RUN contact closure (VFD FOR/RUN to DCM). Topology of the historical Bouni analog board: ILD217 phototransistor switches the VFD 10 V reference into a two-stage RC filter and a TS912 follower; a second ILD217 channel is the RUN contact. Deviation from the original: the host and VFD grounds are NOT tied together (the original shared one GND); the VFD side is a separate field domain GND_VFD referenced only through the optocoupler.
analog.scope: One VFD, one analog speed channel, one RUN contact. No direction, no feedback input, no relay, no mains. Works only with a VFD that provides a 10 V reference terminal and accepts 0-10 V on an analog input with a dry-contact RUN/FOR input. Accuracy: 96-99 % of full scale at 100 % PWM; mid-range error about +1.1 % (see analysis); no tighter claim.

socket.rationale: P gives hardware PWM on pins 7, 8, 9 and a GPIO on pin 6 (CLAUDE.md section 3). Pin 7 is a greedy PWM pin; pin 6 is the RUN GPIO. See questions.md Q4/Q5 for the host-header mapping (GC or GD on the V2 snapshot).

chain_policy.summary: J2 repeats J1 pin for pin. Pins 1, 2, 10 are direct copper. Pins 3..9 each pass through their own cuttable solder jumper JP3..JP9. Pins 6 and 7 (RUN, PWM) are consumed locally and shipped OPEN so a downstream board never sees the spindle signals; pins 3, 4, 5, 8, 9 are bridged.
chain_policy.kind: point-to-point continuation of pins that are not consumed (cable forwarding), not a shared bus.
chain_policy.resources_used: GPIO on pin 6 and the PWM channel on pin 7 are exclusive to this board; PWM pins 8 and 9 and GPIO pin 3 remain available downstream.
chain_policy.terminations: None: no pull-ups or terminations are forwarded. R3/R4 pull-downs sit on J1 pins 7/6 only (upstream of JP6/JP7).
chain_policy.chain_current: Pins 1/2/10 are straight copper at >= 0.4 mm; this board draws 0 mA from +3V3/+5V, so the whole host allocation is available downstream; downstream sum is bounded by the host regulator and the SHF contact rating (rating not verified).
chain_policy.cut_downstream: Cutting or opening JP3..JP9 disconnects the downstream signals without touching +3V3, +5V, GND (direct) or the local circuit.

analog.external_power_rule: No 12-24 V input exists: the CLAUDE.md "source from Gadgeteer 5 V" jumper rule is not applicable. The only external supply is the VFD 10 V reference (terminal 1), a current-limited low-power reference that this board only loads (about 3 mA).

domains.HOST: Gadgeteer rails and signals: +3V3, +5V, GND, PWM_IN, RUN_EN, GAD_P*, CHAIN_P*; U1 pins 1-4. Netclass HOST.
domains.FIELD (GND_VFD): Everything wired to the VFD: VFD_10V, VFD_AOUT, VFD_RUN, VFD_DCM, GND_VFD and the internal analog nets AN_RAW/AN_F1/AN_F2/AN_BUF/UNUSED_B; U1 pins 5-8, U2, R5-R8, C1-C3, D1, J3. Netclass FIELD.

field_interface.J3_terminal: Phoenix PT 1,5/5-3,5-H (1984646), 3.5 mm, wire entry facing the south edge. Pin 1 10V IN (VFD reference, input to this board), pin 2 0-10V OUT (to VFD analog input), pin 3 GND VFD (to VFD analog common), pin 4 RUN (to VFD forward/run input), pin 5 DCM (to VFD digital common).
field_interface.viewing_direction: Viewed from the south edge looking at the wire-entry openings, pin 1 is on the left (west). Pin 1 marked on silkscreen and by the footprint.

electrical.vfd_10v_in: Expected 9.5-10.5 V from the VFD reference, load <= 3.1 mA (R5 branch <= 2.0 mA at 9.6 V + U2 supply current assumed <= 1.1 mA). Wrong voltage above 12 V is clamped only by D1 (SM712) and will likely destroy U2; U2 abs max supply is believed to be 16-18 V (TS912 PDF unread).
electrical.aout: 0 to about 9.6 V (>= 9.5 V guaranteed by U1 VCEsat <= 0.4 V at IC 2.5 mA, IF 10 mA, ILD217T p.2), source impedance 100 ohm (R8), intended load >= 10 kohm (VFD analog input impedance unknown, assumption Q10). Settling 10-90 % about 40 ms, 99 % about 85 ms.
electrical.run_contact: Floating phototransistor between RUN (U1.6 collector) and DCM (U1.5 emitter): BVCEO 70 V, VCEsat <= 0.4 V at IC 2.5 mA, polarity RUN = collector (more positive), DCM = emitter. Assumed VFD wetting current <= 5 mA at <= 30 V (assumption Q10).

analysis.ild217_drive: IF per LED = (VOH - VF)/220 R with VOH >= VDD - 0.4 V (assumed 8 mA GPIO spec): typical 7.7 mA, range 4.8-11.2 mA (abs max 30 mA). Two LEDs at once <= 22.4 mA from two GPIO pins, none from the rails.
analysis.full_scale: Node AN_RAW high level = 10 V - VCEsat(ILD217T) >= 9.6 V (spec point IC 2.5 mA; actual IC = 2.0 mA at 9.6 V across 4.7 k, inside the spec point).
analysis.filter: R6 100 k / C1 47 nF then R7 47 k / C2 100 nF (values swapped relative to the original 47 k/47 n then 100 k/100 n so that R5 4.7 k loading k = R5/(R5+R6) = 4.5 %, equal to the original 2.2 k/(47 k+2.2 k)). Cascade attenuation computed: 1 kHz -58.9 dB (13.9 mV pk-pk ripple for 9.6 V 50 % duty), 2 kHz -70.9 dB (3.5 mV), 20 kHz -110.9 dB (0.04 mV); 10-90 % step 40 ms, 99 % 85 ms.
analysis.dc_nonlinearity: Vc = D*Vh/(1 - k(1-D)), Vh = 9.6 V, k = 0.045: error vs ideal +40 mV at D 0.1, +84 mV at 0.25, +110 mV at 0.5 (+1.1 % of 10 V), +82 mV at 0.75, +39 mV at 0.9, 0 at the ends. Firmware/VFD gain calibrates the 96 % top.
analysis.pwm_frequency_risk: V1 default pwm_period 1000 us = 1 kHz (page). The V2 snapshot hwpwm default is 20 kHz (Hal TEST_pwm.cpp asserts 20000 Hz), where ILD217T emitter-follower switching time (not specified in the Vishay datasheet) may distort the duty cycle. Mitigation in firmware: sigmadeltapwm output type (2 kHz FastTicker in the snapshot) or lowering the PWM timer frequency; bench-measure transfer at the chosen frequency (qualification Q9).

power_budget.note: No Gadgeteer rail current is consumed (rule PWR-01/02: nothing to allocate); GPIO current is within the assumed 8 mA output spec at 220 R.

safe_states.reset_or_floating_gpio: R3 (PWM) and R4 (RUN) 10 k pull-downs keep both LEDs off: AOUT = 0 V, RUN contact open.
safe_states.host_unpowered_or_cable_removed: LEDs unpowered: AOUT 0 V, RUN open. VFD side is independent of the host supply.
safe_states.vfd_10v_absent: AOUT 0 V (U2 unpowered, output pulled down by R5 path), RUN contact still follows RUN_EN (a VFD that is off just ignores it).
safe_states.brownout: Same as host unpowered below the LED forward voltage.
safe_states.warning: A GPIO that boots as a driven high output during reset would start the spindle: firmware/host-header behaviour is not verified (qualification item).

protection.vfd_terminals: D1 SM712-02HTG (asymmetric -7/+12 V standoff, GND_VFD common) across 10V IN and 0-10V OUT to GND_VFD, placed at the J3 entry. R8 100 ohm limits ESD/capacitive-load current into U2 output. U1 collector-emitter 70 V covers RUN/DCM; no clamp on RUN/DCM (Q28).
protection.host_side: No clamps on GPIO pins (R1/R2 220 R in series; LED reverse 6 V abs max is never reached with a 3.3 V source).
protection.not_protected: Wrong voltage above 12 V on terminal 1 or 2, reversed 10 V, VFD-side hot plug. Silkscreen warns.

firmware_interface.status: SmoothieV2 snapshot has NO analog spindle module. A spindle is a switch module instance named "spindle" (CommandShell.cpp looks up Module "switch","spindle"). For this board use a hwpwm or sigmadeltapwm switch on header pin 7 for speed plus a second digital switch on pin 6 for RUN, both on M3/M5; S scaling and a combined M3/S mapping are unverified.
firmware_interface.v1_reference_config: spindle.type analog; spindle.pwm_pin 2.4; spindle.pwm_period 1000; spindle.switch_on_pin 2.6; spindle.max_rpm; spindle.min_rpm (page).
firmware_interface.host_pins: Chosen for GC (pin 6 PI5, pin 7 PI6 per headers.md) or GD (pin 6 PE9, pin 7 PE11); board does not depend on which. Header pin functions differ from the canonical P row (PWM on 6-9): treated as compatible because pin 6 is used as a plain digital output.

pcb.outline_rule: Rectangle, square corners (or <= 1 mm radius). Target is the scratch placement fit (parts max x 38.98, max y 38.45 incl. courtyards). May grow to the limit only if routing fails, with the reason logged in the version notes; report the actual size. A later revision must try to shrink and align per rules CMP-01..11 / ELG.
pcb.origin: top-left corner, x east, y south; positions in mm
pcb.finish: ENIG (flat pads for 1.27 mm sockets, SOIC, 0402 and solder jumpers); HASL is not acceptable for the 0402 and SOIC-20 pads.
pcb.layer_choice: 2 layers: DC and <= 2 kHz-equivalent analog, 3.3 V logic, a few mA; no impedance control, no thermal need. Each domain gets its own GND pour on both layers, separated by the barrier strip.
pcb.datum: H1 centre (10.0, 21.0) = mechanical datum; X/Y axes parallel to the board edges.
pcb.hole_note: Two M3 NPTH (MountingHole_3.2mm_M3, no pad, no net: rule RND-03) centred on the barrier line beside U1: 20.0 mm apart, whole 20 mm offsets from the datum (H2 = datum + (20, 0)). Four holes do not fit under the sockets and terminal. Holes sit in copper-free barrier strip so a screw cannot bridge domains; keepout radius 3.5 mm copper/silk, 3.2 mm to component bodies.
pcb.fabricator_assumption: Generic 2-layer prototype service (JLCPCB-class capability, not yet confirmed with a fabricator): min track/space 0.127 mm, min drill 0.3 mm, min annular ring 0.13 mm, mask dam 0.1 mm. The contract uses >= 0.2 mm clearance, >= 0.25 mm tracks and 0.6/0.3 mm vias, i.e. margin above those limits. Unverified until a fabricator capability sheet is attached (rules FAB-05/FAB-06, L005).
pcb.stackup: 2 layers, FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz (35 um) copper both sides, black solder mask both sides, white silkscreen; declare in the .kicad_pcb stackup (gate-board stackup.py black_stackup pattern). Dielectric/Tg not specified: no controlled impedance (RS-485 at <= 500 kbps over twisted pair, analog DC, 3.3 V logic <= 1 MHz).

placement.north_edge: J1 (IN) x 10, J2 (CHAIN) x 30, y 4.0, rotation 0 (notch south); courtyards y 0.85-7.15.
placement.host_region: y 7.15-19.5: chain jumpers JP3..JP9 in two rows (y 9.8: JP3-JP6 at x 14/18/22/26; y 12.6: JP7-JP9 at x 16/20/24); R1..R4 in a row at y 15.6 (R2 x 14, R1 x 26, R4 x 10, R3 x 30); host test points TP1-TP3 (bottom side) west at x 4.5.
placement.barrier: U1 (ILD217T) at (20, 21) rotation 270: host pins 1-4 on the north row (y 18.525), field pins 5-8 on the south row (y 23.475); copper-free strip y 19.5-22.5 across the full width (3.0 mm = pad gap); holes H1/H2 on y 21.
placement.field_region: y 22.5-39: U2 (TS912) at (7, 29.2); R5/R6/C1/R7/C2/R8 in one row at y 26.2 (x 13/17/21/25/29/32.5), C3 at (7, 25.6), D1 at (37, 27.5), J3 pads at y 33.4 starting x 13.5, wire entry south, field test points TP4-TP6 (bottom side) at x 35.5.
placement.tolerance: Positions are initial intent, courtyard-checked with tools/scratch_place_check.py (0 issues). The layout stage may move parts up to 3 mm; it must keep: host parts north of y 19.5, field parts south of y 22.5, holes on the 20 mm grid, J1/J2 on the north edge, J3 on the south edge, D1 at the J3 entry, U2 supply cap C3 within 3 mm of U2.
placement.alignment: J1/J2 on one y; jumpers on a 4.0 x 2.8 mm grid, rotation 0; R/C row on y 26.2 and 15.6; J3 pads on y 33.4.

keepouts.layers: F.Cu and B.Cu, all item types

keepouts.shape: circle r 3.5 mm around H1, H2
keepouts.rule: No copper or text; components bodies >= 3.2 mm.

keepouts.name: solder jumpers

netclasses.FIELD_ANALOG: AN_RAW, AN_F1, AN_F2: width 0.25, no vias

GND_VFD.rule: Field pour both layers; U2.4/U2.5, R5, C1, C2, C3, D1.3, J3.3, TP6 connect to the pour with 0.3 mm tracks or via stitching; no connection to host GND anywhere.

GND.rule: Host pour (north) both layers; U1.2/U1.4, R3, R4, J1.10/J2.10, TP3.

AN_BUF.rule: U2.1, U2.2 and R8.1 only; feedback from the output pin before R8.

AN_RAW.rule: U1.7, R5.1, R6.1 only; keep <= 8 mm.

signal.VFD_RUN/VFD_DCM: U1.6/U1.5 to J3.4/J3.5, 0.25 mm, no pour between them and host nets.

domain_clearance.proof: Prove the rule is active by a temporary deliberate violation (move a host track within 2 mm of a field pad, run DRC, expect a violation, revert) before trusting a clean DRC (rule REL-06).

barrier.package_limit: ILD217T creepage 4 mm / clearance 4 mm (Vishay p.2); KiCad SOIC-8 pad gap 3.0 mm is the PCB limit. VIOTM 6000 V, VIORM 560 V, test 4000 Vrms 1 s.
barrier.assumed_working_voltage: Design intent <= 60 V DC / 42 V peak between HOST and FIELD (SELV VFD control terminals). Spacing derivation per IEC 60664-1/62368-1/61010-1 is NOT done (open item, Q19): inputs recorded: pollution degree 2, FR-4 material group IIIa (CTI >= 175), altitude <= 2000 m, no coating, basic insulation intent.
barrier.not_claimed: No mains-referenced VFD control terminal support, no reinforced insulation, no standard compliance; human review required.

schematic_rules.symbols: U1 Isolator:LTV-827S pins 1-8 numbered like ILD217T (A1 K1 A2 K2 E2 C2 E1 C1: checked numerically as 1..8 only; function check against ILD217T p.1 is a schematic-stage task, override the footprint field with Package_SO SOIC-8). U2 Amplifier_Operational:TS912 (units A, B, power). D1 Diode:SM712_SOT23 (pins 1,2 lines, 3 common). R/C Device:R, Device:C. J1/J2 Connector_Generic:Conn_02x05_Odd_Even. J3 Connector_Generic:Conn_01x05. JP* Jumper:SolderJumper_2_Open/Bridged, exclude_from_bom. TP Connector:TestPoint.
schematic_rules.erc: Target 0 violations with default severities, no exclusions. Add PWR_FLAG on VFD_10V and GND_VFD (supplied from J3), on GND (from J1). +3V3 and +5V carry no power pins. U2 unit B: IN+ to GND_VFD, IN- to OUT (UNUSED_B net). Never lower severities.

board_specific_rules: GND (host) and GND_VFD never touch: no track, via, pour, test pad or footprint bridges them; netlist check = 0 shared nets between domains except through U1 (optical).
U1 is the only part spanning the barrier; no other component bridges the strip.
U2 has C3 within 3 mm; pin 4 and pin 5 go to GND_VFD; unit B is tied off, never floating.
R8 sits between the U2 feedback node and J3.2; feedback is taken at U2.1, not after R8.
Default jumper state shipped: JP6 and JP7 OPEN, JP3 JP4 JP5 JP8 JP9 bridged; printed on silkscreen and verified in the PCB footprint variants.
No LED, no relay, no firmware; 3V3/5V pins are pass-through only.

rs485.name: Bouni spindle module B: Gadgeteer UART to isolated RS-485 (Modbus RTU) for a VFD such as the Huanyang
rs485.function: Half-duplex galvanically isolated RS-485 transceiver for the Gadgeteer U socket: host TX (pin 4) to D, host RX (pin 5) from R, host GPIO (pin 6) to DE and /RE tied together as direction. The historical Bouni board used a non-isolated MAX3485 at 3.3 V with a 120 ohm termination on a solder jumper. Deviation: this board uses TI ISOW1412 (signal and power isolated, integrated DC-DC, 5 kVrms/reinforced, >= 8 mm package creepage), powered from +5V (VDD) with the logic referenced to +3V3 (VIO), so a VFD control-ground offset or noise cannot reach the host.
rs485.scope: One RS-485 port, half duplex, <= 500 kbps (ISOW1412 limit), Modbus RTU typically 9600 8N1 for a Huanyang. No firmware, no bias network (receiver is fail-safe for open/short/idle), no shield termination. Hardware only: the SmoothieV2 snapshot has no Modbus spindle module (Q6).

socket.rationale: U = UART: pin 4 TX(G), pin 5 RX(G), pin 6 GPIO for direction (CLAUDE.md section 3). K (UART + RTS/CTS) would allow hardware DE on RTS but the Smoothie modbus spindle uses a dir_pin GPIO; U is the more common header (GB UART1, GD UART0).

gadgeteer_pin_map.local_use: VIO of U1 (U1.1), C1, R2/R3 pull-ups; forwarded to J2
VDD of U1 (U1.9), C2/C3/C4; forwarded to J2
not used locally; forwarded (GPIO! of the U socket)
UART_TX: host transmit data, U1 D (U1.2)
UART_RX: U1 R (U1.4) to host receive data, R2 10 k pull-up
RS485_DIR: U1 DE and /RE tied (U1.3, U1.5), R1 10 k pull-down; high = transmit
not used locally; [UN] on the U socket; forwarded unchanged
not used locally; [UN] on the U socket; forwarded unchanged
not used locally; [UN] on the U socket; forwarded unchanged
host GND: U1 GND1/GNDIO, caps, pull-downs; forwarded to J2

chain_policy.summary: J2 repeats J1 pin for pin. Pins 1, 2, 10 are direct copper. Pins 3..9 each pass through a cuttable solder jumper JP3..JP9. Pins 4, 5, 6 (TX, RX, DIR) are consumed locally and shipped OPEN; pins 3, 7, 8, 9 are bridged.
chain_policy.kind: cable forwarding of power and the unconsumed GPIO only. A UART cannot be shared by two boards; bridging JP4-JP6 is allowed only for a deliberate listener downstream and is not supported.
chain_policy.resources_used: The host UART (TX/RX) and the DIR GPIO on pin 6 are exclusive to this board.
chain_policy.terminations: The bus termination (SJ1 + R4 120 ohm) is on the FIELD side; no host-side pull-ups are forwarded (R2 on RX and R3 on FLT are on J1 side nets, upstream of JP5; R3 is on ISO_FLT_N which is not on the socket).
chain_policy.chain_current: Pass-through +5V trace >= 0.4 mm; this board takes <= 0.15 A of the host 5 V (budget below), the rest of the shared 3 A remains for downstream boards; the +5V ISOW start-up pulse (250 mA for tens of us) is absorbed by C2/C3/C4 at the board.
chain_policy.cut_downstream: JP3..JP9 can be cut individually without touching +3V3, +5V, GND or the local circuit.

rs485.external_power_rule: No 12-24 V input: the CLAUDE.md "source from Gadgeteer 5 V" jumper rule is not applicable. The field side is powered only by the isolated DC-DC of U1 (VISO, 3.3 V, MODE = GND2); no external supply connector exists.

domains.HOST: Gadgeteer rails and signals: +3V3, +5V, GND, UART_TX, UART_RX, RS485_DIR, ISO_FLT_N, GAD_P*, CHAIN_P*; U1 pins 1-10. Netclass HOST.
domains.FIELD (GND_ISO): GND2_OUT, VISO_OUT, VISO_IN, GND_ISO, BUS_P, BUS_N, TERM_MID; U1 pins 11-20, C5-C9, FB1, FB2, D1, SJ1, R4, J3. Netclass FIELD.

field_interface.J3_terminal: Phoenix PT 1,5/3-3,5-H (1984620, inferred), 3.5 mm, wire entry facing the south edge. Pin 1 D+ (BUS_P: U1 Y and A, the non-inverting line: more positive than D- when TXD = 1 / bus idle), pin 2 D- (BUS_N: Z and B), pin 3 GND ISO (isolated reference, optional to wire).
field_interface.viewing_direction: Viewed from the south edge looking at the wire-entry openings, pin 1 is on the left (west).
field_interface.polarity_note: Logic-defined (DIG-04): D+ is the line that is high for TXD = 1. A/B names of VFDs differ; if a Huanyang does not answer, swap the pair (harmless). Verify on hardware (Q12).

electrical.bus_range: ISOW1412 recommended -7..+12 V on A/B w.r.t. GND2, abs max -12..+15 V; HBM +-16 kV, IEC 61000-4-2 contact +-8 kV (datasheet 6.1/6.2). D1 SM712 adds clamping at the terminal.
electrical.data_rate: <= 500 kbps (ISOW1412); intended 9600 baud; cable length and wiring assumptions to be published after bench test (calculated, not tested).
electrical.receiver: Fail-safe for open, short and idle bus (datasheet features); 1/8 unit load; no external bias.
electrical.driver: VOD >= 1.5 V into 54 ohm (MODE = GND2, 3.3 V RS-485 mode); short-circuit current <= 180 mA.
electrical.termination: SJ1 + R4 120 ohm across D+/D- : shipped OPEN (CHN-04, DIG-05): close only at the physical end of the cable; the VFD end owns the other termination if its manual calls for one.

analysis.logic_levels: VIO = +3V3 (VIH = 0.7 x VIO = 2.31 V, VIL = 0.3 x VIO = 0.99 V; R pin output VOH >= VIO - 0.3 V at 2 mA, rated +-2 mA at VIO 3-3.6 V). Host 3.3 V GPIO drive D, DE, /RE directly; no level shifter. This is why ADM2587E was rejected at 5 V (VIH 3.5 V) and why 3.3 V operation of it would draw up to 125 mA from the unknown 3.3 V budget.
analysis.power_5v: VDD = +5V, MODE = GND2. IDD typ/max at VDD 5 V +-10 %: receiver only 16/28 mA; driver on, 120 ohm 500 kbps 62/86 mA; driver on, 54 ohm 90/122 mA; converter disabled 0.23/0.45 mA. Budget reserved from the host 5 V: 150 mA steady (5 % of the shared ~3 A), 300 mA short peaks (datasheet 9.3 asks the upstream source for >= 300 mA typical current limit).
analysis.power_3v3: VIO current <= 7.2 mA max (driver+receiver enabled, dynamic) + R2 and R3 pull-ups 0.33 mA each when low: budget 10 mA from +3V3 (self-imposed; host 3.3 V allocation unknown).
analysis.thermal: Worst PD about 0.6 W (122 mA x 5 V) at theta-JA 68.5 C/W (test board) => about 40 K rise; ambient limit 105-125 C (MODE = GND2, no extra VISO current used). Estimate only; measure on a populated board.
analysis.capacitor_derating: Bulk caps are 10 uF 16 V X5R 0805: at 5 V DC bias effective capacitance may fall to about 50-65 % (Murata DC-bias curve not retrieved); datasheet minimum is 10 uF, so C2/C7/C9 remain >= the vendor value only if the bias curve holds: verify with the Murata curve or fit 25 V parts (open item).

power_budget.ma_note: Budgets, not measurements; no host allocation is known (rule PWR-02: kept as stated assumptions).

safe_states.reset_or_floating_gpio: R1 10 k pull-down on RS485_DIR keeps DE low and /RE low: driver disabled (high impedance), receiver enabled. U1 itself also has DE pull-down and /RE pull-up internally when floating; with DE and /RE tied R1 defines the level.
safe_states.host_unpowered_or_cable_removed: VDD absent: converter off, bus pins high impedance (datasheet: glitch-free power up/down). VIO absent while VDD present: unsupported, avoid (Q11).
safe_states.brownout: VDD UVLO 2.55/2.93 V; VIO UVLO 1.0/1.7 V; bus idle fail-safe high.
safe_states.output_meaning: No actuator output exists; the VFD acts only on valid Modbus frames. Energising the spindle remains a deliberate firmware action (CFG-05).

protection.bus: D1 SM712-02HTG from D+ and D- to GND_ISO at the J3 entry (asymmetric -7/+12 V standoff matches the RS-485 common-mode range); U1 has +-16 kV HBM / +-8 kV IEC contact on the bus pins itself. No series resistors or common-mode choke (EMC-10; option documented in Q17).
protection.supply: Host 5 V is shared and regulated; no fuse, TVS or reverse protection on the Gadgeteer rails (GSC-02). C4/C5 10 nF 0402, FB1/FB2 ferrites per TI layout guideline 4.
protection.not_protected: Sustained wrong voltage > +15 V or < -12 V on D+/D-, mains on the bus, VFD-side hot plug.

firmware_interface.status: SmoothieV2 snapshot has no Modbus spindle module (no "spindle" source apart from the switch-named lookup in CommandShell.cpp). The board is a plain UART to RS-485 bridge usable by any future driver.
firmware_interface.v1_reference_config: spindle.type modbus; spindle.vfd_type huanyang; spindle.rx_pin 2.6; spindle.tx_pin 2.4; spindle.dir_pin 2.5 (page). Huanyang: PD001 2, PD002 2, PD163 1, PD164 1 (9600), PD165 3 (8N1 RTU).
firmware_interface.host_pins: Recommended GB (pin 4 PB9 UART1 TX, pin 5 PH14 UART1 RX, pin 6 PK0 as DIR) or GD (UART0 on pins 4/5, pin 6 PE9). DIR must be driven high only while transmitting; turnaround timing is firmware responsibility.

pcb.outline_rule: Rectangle, square corners (or <= 1 mm radius). Target is the scratch placement fit (parts max x 39.24, max y 41.05 incl. courtyards). May grow to the limit only if routing fails, with the reason logged; report the actual size. A later revision must try to shrink per CMP/ELG rules.
pcb.origin: top-left corner, x east, y south; positions in mm
pcb.finish: ENIG (flat pads for 1.27 mm sockets, SOIC, 0402 and solder jumpers); HASL is not acceptable for the 0402 and SOIC-20 pads.
pcb.layer_choice: 2 layers: TI states CISPR 32 Class B is met on a two-layer PCB with the two ferrite beads and the < 1 mm 10 nF capacitors; signals <= 500 kbps; no impedance control (RS-485 at <= 500 kbps). 4 layers would add inter-domain capacitance without need.
pcb.datum: H1 centre (10.0, 22.5) = mechanical datum; X/Y axes parallel to the board edges.
pcb.hole_note: Two M3 NPTH centred on the barrier line beside U1, 20.0 mm apart (whole 20 mm offsets from the datum). Body clearance U1 to hole centre is 3.6 mm (screw head r 3.0 mm); courtyards overlap by 0.2 mm, accepted (body-based rule 3.2 mm). Holes lie in the copper-free strip. Four holes do not fit.
pcb.fabricator_assumption: Generic 2-layer prototype service (JLCPCB-class capability, not yet confirmed with a fabricator): min track/space 0.127 mm, min drill 0.3 mm, min annular ring 0.13 mm, mask dam 0.1 mm. The contract uses >= 0.2 mm clearance, >= 0.25 mm tracks and 0.6/0.3 mm vias, i.e. margin above those limits. Unverified until a fabricator capability sheet is attached (rules FAB-05/FAB-06, L005).
pcb.stackup: 2 layers, FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz (35 um) copper both sides, black solder mask both sides, white silkscreen; declare in the .kicad_pcb stackup (gate-board stackup.py black_stackup pattern). Dielectric/Tg not specified: no controlled impedance (RS-485 at <= 500 kbps over twisted pair, analog DC, 3.3 V logic <= 1 MHz).

placement.north_edge: J1 (IN) x 10, J2 (CHAIN) x 30, y 4.0, rotation 0 (notch south).
placement.barrier: U1 (ISOW1412DFMR, custom SOIC-20 DFM0020A footprint) at (20, 22.5) rotation 270: host pins 1-10 on the north row (y 17.65, pin 1 at the east end), field pins 11-20 on the south row (y 27.35, pin 11 at the west end); copper-free strip y 18.7-26.3 (7.6 mm) across the full width.
placement.tolerance: Initial intent, courtyard-checked with tools/scratch_place_check.py (0 issues). The layout stage may move parts up to 3 mm; it must keep: host parts north of y 18.7, field parts south of y 26.3, TI keepout (below), C4/C5 < 1 mm from their pins (TI: required for emissions), FB1/FB2 per TI Figure 9-7, D1 at the J3 entry, holes on the 20 mm grid.
placement.alignment: J1/J2 on one y; jumpers on a 4.0 x 2.8 mm grid; field caps on y 29.8-30; J3 pads on y 36.0.

keepouts.name: barrier strip
keepouts.shape: rectangle x 0..40, y 18.7..26.3 (U1 pad gap 7.6 mm)
keepouts.layers: F.Cu and B.Cu, all item types
keepouts.rule: No tracks, vias, pours, test pads or silkscreen; only U1 pads bound it.

keepouts.name: TI VISOOUT keepout (required)
keepouts.shape: region within 4 mm of U1 pads 11 and 12 (centres (14.285, 27.35) and (15.555, 27.35))
keepouts.rule: TI datasheet 9.4.1 item 5 and Figure 9-7: no metal traces or ground pour within 4 mm of VISOOUT (pin 12) and GND2 (pin 11) except the VISO_OUT/GND2_OUT nets of C5, C6, C7, FB1.1, FB2.1 placed as in the figure; the GND_ISO pour is cut back 4 mm. MODE (pin 13) must tie to pin 11 or 12 (to GND2_OUT, a short bottom-layer jumper).

keepouts.name: mounting holes
keepouts.shape: circle r 3.5 mm around H1, H2
keepouts.rule: No copper or text; component bodies >= 3.2 mm.

keepouts.name: solder jumpers
keepouts.rule: No silkscreen on pads or gaps; no vias/tracks under bridged strips.

keepouts.name: bus pair
keepouts.shape: BUS_P/BUS_N from U1 pads 17-20 to D1 and J3
keepouts.rule: Route D+/D- together (equal length +-2 mm, no stubs except D1 and the SJ1/R4 branch); U1.17-U1.20 (BUS_P) are joined by a bottom-layer jumper under the BUS_N pair via vias outside the pad rows.

netclasses.FIELD: all field nets; width 0.25, VISO_OUT/VISO_IN 0.4, clearance 0.2

+5V.rule: J1.2 to U1.9 and the chain J2.2 as a spur from the C4/C3/C2 node; bypass loop U1.9-C4-U1.10 < 1 mm, symmetric VDD/GND1 traces to the caps (TI 9.4.1 item 3).

+3V3.rule: J1.1 to U1.1, C1, R2, R3 and J2.1.

VISO_OUT/GND2_OUT.rule: Short, symmetric (TI item 3) to C5 (< 1 mm), C6, C7, then FB1/FB2 to VISO_IN/GND_ISO.

power_like.GND: Host pour north of the barrier, both layers.
power_like.GND_ISO: Field pour south of the barrier, both layers, cut back 4 mm at pads 11/12.

domain_clearance.proof: Prove the rule is active with a temporary violation before trusting a clean DRC (REL-06). The 7.6 mm U1 pad gap passes a 7.5 mm rule by 0.1 mm; confirm the footprint pad gap in the saved board.

barrier.package_limit: ISOW1412 external creepage and clearance > 8 mm, DTI > 17 um (signal) / > 120 um (power), VIOTM 7071 Vpk, VIOWM 1500 Vdc / 1000 Vrms, CTI > 600, material group I, PD 2 (datasheet 6.6). TI land pattern gives a pad-edge gap of 7.6 mm (below the 8 mm package value): the PCB, not the package, limits the barrier.
barrier.assumed_working_voltage: Design intent <= 60 V DC / 42 V peak between HOST and FIELD (VFD RS-485 port); the isolator is rated far higher but the PCB spacing (7.6 mm) is the stated limit. Spacing derivation per IEC 60664-1 not done (Q19).
barrier.not_claimed: No claim of reinforced insulation or standard compliance at the system level; the ISOW1412DFM (non-B) device is reinforced-rated but the PCB is not verified; human review required. A board slot cannot repair package spacing (ADD-05) and none is planned.

schematic_rules.symbols: U1 needs a locally authored symbol in attempt/symbols/Smoothie_Bouni.kicad_sym named ISOW1412DFM (KiCad stock has no ISOW1412): pin numbers/names per the datasheet table 5-1 (1 VIO, 2 D, 3 DE, 4 R, 5 RE, 6 GNDIO, 7 OUT, 8 EN/FLT, 9 VDD, 10 GND1, 11 GND2, 12 VISOOUT, 13 MODE, 14 IN, 15 GISOIN, 16 VISOIN, 17 Y, 18 Z, 19 B, 20 A) with types: VIO/VDD power_in, VISOOUT power_out, VISOIN/GISOIN/GND2/GND1/GNDIO power_in, logic pins input/output, OUT unconnected (no-connect flag). D1 Diode:SM712_SOT23. FB Device:FerriteBead. R/C Device:R, Device:C. J3 Connector_Generic:Conn_01x03. SJ1 Jumper:SolderJumper_2_Open.
schematic_rules.erc: Target 0 violations with default severities, no exclusions. PWR_FLAG on +3V3, +5V, GND (from J1), VISO_IN and GND_ISO (the field supply is produced by U1: mark the nets via the symbol power_out pin and PWR_FLAG on GND_ISO). U1.7 gets a no-connect flag. Never lower severities.
schematic_rules.sheet_notes: Pin map, chain defaults, D+/D- logic polarity, termination SJ1 open, TI layout rules, expected readings.
schematic_rules.fields: Every symbol carries Manufacturer and MPN equal to parts[]; jumpers/test points exclude_from_bom.

silkscreen.rules: White on black; min text 0.8 mm / 0.15 mm stroke; bottom mirrored; nothing on pads, jumper gaps, hole keepouts or the barrier strip.

test_points.rules: Bottom-side 1.0 mm pads, >= 2 mm apart; observation only; expected readings: VISO_IN 3.135-3.465 V w.r.t. GND_ISO (datasheet 6.9), ISO_FLT_N high (3.3 V) when healthy, D+ - D- > +200 mV idle (driver off, fail-safe).

models.U1: ${KICAD9_3DMODEL_DIR}/Package_SO.3dshapes/SOIC-20W_7.5x12.8mm_P1.27mm.step (body 7.5 x 12.8 is the same JEDEC MS-013 outline; pads differ)

board_specific_rules: GND (host) and GND_ISO never touch except through the isolator: no track, via, pour, test pad or footprint bridges them; mounting holes are NPTH with no net.
U1 is the only part spanning the barrier; D1, SJ1, R4, J3 and C5-C9, FB1, FB2 are FIELD only; C1-C4, R1-R3 and J1/J2 are HOST only.

U1 pin 7 (OUT) is a no-connect; pin 8 EN/FLT has the 10 k pull-up R3 to +3V3 (>= 5 k per datasheet) and TP7; pin 14 (IN) to GND_ISO; pin 13 (MODE) to GND2_OUT = 3.3 V RS-485 mode; pin 12 to pin 16 only through FB1; pin 11 to pin 15 only through FB2.
DE (pin 3) and /RE (pin 5) are tied together at U1 and connect only to R1, TP1 and J1.6 (via JP6 open, J2.6 is not driven).
